intro: Trying to find Illinois scholarships in the USA with awards under ten thousand dollars usually means sorting through a wide mix of smaller and mid-range programs, not chasing one giant prize. This filtered view brings together a focused set of listings tied to Illinois, with options that touch areas like education, STEM, medicine, community, arts, and more. You can compare programs for high school seniors, early college students, graduate students, and adult non-traditional applicants, while keeping an eye on residency or citizenship language where it appears. Award amounts vary by listing, and deadlines differ by program, so it’s smart to check dates promptly and verify every requirement on the official page before you apply. Some listings may be lighter-touch, while others can ask for more materials.
